title: Impeachment court issues show-cause order to VP spokesman

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Friday issued a show-cause order to Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesman Paolo Panelo over statements that allegedly cast doubt on the integrity of senator-judges.

The order, which carries a potential contempt citation, was approved at the start of Day 45 of Duterte’s impeachment trial following a formal motion by Sen. Erwin Tulfo. No senator-judge raised an objection.
Tulfo flagged Panelo’s public remarks, arguing that the spokesman disrespected the tribunal by commenting on the senators while his principal is on trial.

“He’s not party to this case, but he is the spokesperson of the Vice President. I mean, you are the spokesperson of the Vice President that is on trial here, and then you would comment on the senator-judges, the impeachment court. It seems there is no respect for the impeachment court,” Tulfo said at the trial on Friday.
In response, Panelo maintained that his comments “were fair, made in good faith.”
“I will formally respond to the show-cause order within the period provided upon receipt,” Panelo said in a statement. — Bella Cariaso, Daphne Galvez
